words.gloss: within the limits of the earth

literal: If one achieves enduring fame within the limits of the earth, the world of the gods, without praising the wise sages, will praise them.
translation: If a person achieves enduring fame within the boundaries of this earth, the world of the gods will cease to praise its own wise sages and will instead praise that famous person.
modern: ஒருவர் இந்த நிலவுலகின் எல்லைக்குள் அழியாத புகழைச் செய்வாரானால், தேவர் உலகம் அங்குள்ள அறிஞர்களைப் போற்றாமல், இவரையே போற்றிப் புகழும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of earning lasting fame in the mortal world. It states that if someone achieves enduring fame on earth, even the celestial world of the gods will ignore its own resident sages and wise beings to praise and welcome this extraordinary human. The word 'புலவர்' here refers to the wise or divine scholars of the heavenly realm, and 'புத்தேள் உலகு' refers to the world of the gods. The poet uses this comparison to show that true earthly fame transcends even the glory of the heavens.
